description: A man with slicked-back dark hair, in a dark waistcoat and rolled white sleeves, bends over a wooden workbench wiring a small board. In the foreground a large glowing glass bulb-like vacuum tube with a bright filament sits on the table, with copper coils, a lit oil lamp, glass jars, a dark wooden box and headphones around it. The setting is a dim, cluttered workshop with warm lamplight, in a painterly oil style. No frame or text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.
